INCLUSIVE LEARNING

Every child,
understood as an individual.

Children learn at different paces and in different ways, and some need a little more support along the way. Kabira aims to be a thoughtful, inclusive early-years option for families of children with additional learning or developmental needs, within what a small preschool can realistically offer.

HOW WE APPROACH IT

Getting to know your child,
before assuming anything.

Every child is different, and a label on its own tells us very little. Before your child joins a classroom, we want to understand how they communicate, what helps them feel settled, and where a little extra patience or a different approach might help — not so we can categorise, but so we can support.

WORKING TOGETHER

A conversation,
not a form to fill in.

We rely on parents as the people who know their child best. Where a child has an existing diagnosis, therapy plan or specialist recommendation, we ask families to share it with us so our classroom approach can work alongside it, not around it — through ongoing conversation, not a single admission-day form.

AN HONEST CONVERSATION

We will tell you
what we can offer.

Kabira is a preschool, not a therapy centre or a diagnostic service. We do not provide clinical therapy, medical care or formal special-education certification. What we can offer is a caring classroom environment, a willingness to adapt where reasonably possible, and an honest conversation about whether Kabira is the right fit for your child's needs — before admission, not after.

LET'S TALK BEFORE YOU DECIDE

Tell us about
your child.

The best next step is usually a conversation. Call, WhatsApp or send an enquiry, and our team can talk through your child's needs honestly with you.
